name: google-drive
description: Google Drive connector — list/search/read files via OAuth

ai.insodimension.dimension.title: Google Drive
examples: List the 10 most recently modified files in my Drive
Find my Drive doc about the Q3 roadmap and summarize it
Search my Drive for spreadsheets named 'budget' and read the newest

setup.title: Create (or pick) a Google Cloud project
setup.detail: Free — no billing account required. Any name works, e.g. "My Dimension Drive".

setup.title: Enable the Google Drive API
setup.detail: APIs & Services → Library → search "Google Drive API" → Enable. Creating an OAuth client is NOT enough — without this step the connection succeeds but every Drive call fails.

setup.title: Set up the OAuth consent screen
setup.detail: First time only. Name the app "Dimension Google Drive" — Google shows it as "<name> wants access" on the approval screen. User type External; leave it in Testing and add your own Google account under Test users.

setup.title: Create an OAuth client
setup.detail: Credentials → Create Credentials → OAuth client ID → Application type "Desktop app". No redirect URI to register — Desktop clients accept any loopback port.

setup.title: Copy the Client ID and Client Secret
setup.detail: From the credential you just created — paste both into the form below. They stay on this machine.

form.label: OAuth Client ID
form.help: From your own Google Cloud project (the steps above) — Dimension never ships or shares a client across users.

form.label: OAuth Client Secret
form.help: Google issues one for Desktop app clients even though it isn't treated as secret for installed apps (RFC 8252). Copy it from the same credential page.

scopeOptions.label: Read-only
scopeOptions.detail: List, search, and read files. The agent cannot change anything in your Drive.

scopeOptions.label: Full access
scopeOptions.detail: Also upload, create folders, move/rename, and share files — every mutation asks you first.

failures.match: has not been used in project|is disabled|SERVICE_DISABLED|accessNotConfigured
failures.title: Enable the Google Drive API
failures.detail: Your account connected, but the Google Cloud project has the Drive API turned off. Enable it, wait a minute for it to propagate, then connect again.

failures.title: Reconnect your Google account
failures.detail: The stored token is no longer valid — run Connect again to re-authorize.
